intended_use: bounded educational research prototype; requires an authorized local dataset and training run; not production image generation

proposed_baseline.purpose: experimental 16x16 RGB research baseline that learns a low-resolution pixel-bin distribution from authorized caption/image pairs; not a quality image generator
proposed_baseline.conditioning: Fresh-trained prompt tokenizer and compact prompt-conditioning embedding
proposed_baseline.weights: must be trained from random initialization for this model ID

constraints: This specification does not implement a model or imply image generation works.
Do not reuse fresh-unified-1 language-model weights as image-model weights.
Do not load downloaded pretrained or open-weight model weights.
If free compute is insufficient, stop and document the blocker; do not create paid resources.
Outputs are limited to 16x16 pixels and are not intended to look polished or compete with commercial image generators.
